trigger: The user explicitly rejected the current Step 4 visual direction and prohibited treating SVG generation or file existence as evidence of production-quality design.

userApproval.reason: The current design differs materially from the project-source visual prototypes and is not acceptable as a production-facing game UI.

visualFailureFindings.finding: The screens use a generic dark-purple card-dashboard language instead of a distinctive illustrated mobile game presentation.
Character, enemy, tower, town, shop and reward art are too weak or abstract to carry the Cat's Tower value proposition.
The twelve screens are excessively homogeneous; screen-specific composition and emotional hierarchy are insufficient.
The title, battle and boss screens do not reach the production-density, illustration quality or spectacle established by the project-source prototypes.
The current critical-state presentation is dominated by generic modal sheets and does not preserve enough scene identity or operation context.
No actual browser-rendered screenshot set, large-text proof, reduced-motion proof or user visual approval exists.
XML-valid SVG and deterministic generation were incorrectly treated as progress toward visual acceptance; they prove transport validity, not design quality.

mustNotAuthorize: one-to-one copying of another product's exact layout
copying exact prices, probabilities or live-service values

replacementAcceptance.principle: A design may pass only when the rendered result itself is credible as a production-facing Cat's Tower screen, not because source files exist or validators pass.
requiredForAnchorApproval: Cat's Tower-specific art direction visibly derived from the project-source prototypes
distinct screen identity rather than one reusable dashboard template
actual rendered screenshots shown to the user in this chat
internal comparison against the project-source prototype baseline
self-rejection and redesign when the result does not look production-ready
no expansion to all twelve screens until the anchor direction is credible
requiredForStep4Pass: normal, pending, failure and recovery states
automaticFailConditions: SVG or code validity used as a visual-quality proxy
the design team would not confidently publish the screen in a commercial mobile game

user has not been shown the rendered result

nextAction: Discard the current visual direction as a candidate for final approval, redesign the four anchor screens at production-grade fidelity, conduct an adversarial visual review, then show the actual rendered screens to the user before expanding to S01-S12.
